Surfshark’s Most Annoying Bug: Connection Instantly Fails (Support is Clueless)
Does anyone know how to actually report a bug to Surfshark's development team so they *finally* get it?

Occasionally, Surfshark glitches out and completely blocks any connection. When this happens, the moment you click the "Connect" button, an error message instantly pops up. (Normally, even if there’s a connection issue, the progress bar fills up as it tries to connect). But in this infuriating state, the error appears the exact millisecond you hit connect. Switching to "Automatic" or manually changing the protocols doesn't do a thing.

This issue exclusively appears on the Android version, while the Windows and iOS versions work fine. This fact alone proves that the problem lies within the Surfshark app itself.

To make matters worse, Surfshark’s support team is absolutely terrible and incompetent. Over the past two years, we’ve contacted them more than ten times about this specific issue. They just reply like bots and cannot comprehend what a software bug actually means. They rely entirely on canned responses; the moment you mention a connection issue, they immediately send you the same generic guide on how to manually connect on Windows or from China.

We’ve been constantly updating the app for the past two years, but the issue never goes away. We even uploaded a video of this bug to YouTube and sent them the link, but still, nothing was fixed.

**Here is the link to the video I uploaded for them 8 months ago!:** [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wf\_pVlUKxGo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wf_pVlUKxGo)

Other VPN services like Windscribe, ExpressVPN, Proton, etc., are working fine, and this error exclusively happens within the Surfshark app.

Does anyone know how on earth we can make this team (or company) understand that their app is fundamentally broken? **Is there any way to bypass their support and contact their development/engineering team directly?**
